items.evidence: leverage play --ticks 5 --settings judge-scratch/s1 printed {"tick":5,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":8,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]}: every key of the brief, and tick = N.
The README frame command, run as written from a scratch folder, wrote frame.png; `file` says PNG 800 x 480. All 9 frames I took are 800x480.

The title texts are [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]. 2:down,4:enter gave menu_index 1 at tick 3 and screen settings at tick 5. 2:enter gave screen play at tick 3 with wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5 and texts Score: 0 / Wave 1 of 5 / Gate: 5.
In Settings: 5 x right took volume 8 -> 10 and it stayed 10; 12 x left went down to 0 and stayed 0 (tick 39); 12 x right went to 10 and stayed 10 (ticks 63, 69, 70).

After Down to Language and Right: language es, and the settings texts became [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir, Ajustes, Volumen: 5, Idioma: Español, Atrás]. Title, play (Puntos / Oleada 1 de 5 / Puerta), paused (En pausa, Continuar, Título) and lost (Has perdido, Enter: título) were all Spanish. The frames show the same.
A run with --settings s4 set volume 5 and language es. The next runs with s4 started at tick 1 with es and 5. A fresh folder started with en and 8 (the defaults).
10:up,40:none took guard_y 6 -> 9 in 30 ticks (0.1 per tick = 6/s). Held up, it stopped at 12 (ticks 159-200). Held down, it stopped at 0 (330-400). x is 2 in the frame.
With shoot held from tick 70, bolts appeared at ticks 71, 95, 119, 143 and 167 (24 apart, never more), moving 0.2333 per tick (14/s). A bolt at x 19.9641 on tick 147 was gone on tick 148.
Seed 1, no shooting: wave 1 walkers spawned at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271 and 361 (every 90 ticks) in lanes 2, 4, 8, 6 and 6, at x 20, moving 0.025 per tick (1.5/s). Exactly 5 came before wave 2.

Guard at y 1.6, one bolt at 45: the lane-2 walker went from health 2 to 1 and the bolt was gone (tick 115). A second bolt destroyed it: score 0 -> 10 at tick 210. Guard at y 3: the bolt passed the lane-2 walker, which kept health 2.

No shooting: the walker at x 0.025 was gone at tick 801 and gate went 5 -> 4. At 0 (tick 1161) the screen was lost with texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]. A run that destroyed one walker ended lost with Score: 10 shown.

With --set gate=100: wave 1's last walker was gone at tick 1161 and wave 2 started at tick 1341 (180 ticks = 3 s) with texts Wave 2 of 5. Over waves 1-5 the gate lost 45 health (100 -> 55), so the waves sent 5+7+9+11+13. Wave 2 spawns were 7 (ticks 1341-1881).

My own script (judge-scratch/plan.txt, from the seed-1 lane order) shot every walker twice at the default gate. On tick 4907 the screen was won with score 450 and gate 5, and texts had You won / Score: 450 / Enter: title. Enter on tick 4912 gave the title screen. The won frame shows this.

Escape at tick 100 gave paused. Walkers, bolts and the guard did not change from tick 100 to tick 251, even with up+shoot held. Enter on Resume gave play, and the next tick went on from the same values (walker 17.525 -> 17.5). Escape, Down, Enter on Title gave the title screen.
Two runs with seed 7 and the same ticks and inputs printed byte-identical JSON (cmp). Walker lanes: seed 7 gave 10,6,2,2,4; seed 1 gave 2,4,8,6,6; seed 42 gave 8,8,10,4,10.

play_en.png at tick 420 (guard 2,6.6; walkers 9.525/2 h1 red, 11.775/4, 14.025/8; bolt 14.6/6.6): every one is drawn where the state says (view 36.9 px a unit around 10,6). The gate is drawn at the left edge. The HUD shows Score: 20, Wave 1 of 5, Gate: 5.
title.png: the English menu with Start outlined. title_es.png: Spanish with Ajustes outlined. settings_es.png: Ajustes / Volumen: 5 / Idioma: Español (outlined) / Atrás.

The words are in assets/strings/en.json and es.json, one per language, with the same keys. lib.rs holds no shown words. The README section Adding a language says to copy en.json to <code>.json and change locale, name and values.

The README has a How to play section. Its headless command (with --settings SETTINGS_FOLDER taken literally) and its frame command both ran as written from a scratch folder, with exit 0. They printed the state JSON and wrote an 800x480 frame.png.

defects: texts holds strings from screens under the current one: under Settings it lists the title screen's 4 words (the panel hides them in the frame), and under Pause, Won and Lost it lists the HUD's words. The README says so.
The game has a test-only option --set gate=N that changes the gate's starting health (the README says so).
